package: 1x5 straight pin header, 2.54 mm pitch, through-hole, single row.
description: HX PZ2.54-1x5P ZZ - 1x5 straight pin header, 2.54 mm pitch, through-hole. Manufacturer: Shenzhen Hanxia Electronic Co., Ltd (brand mark 'HANXIA'). Source PDF is a 7-page document downloaded from wmsc.lcsc.com: page 1 (0-based page 0) is the mechanical/electrical drawing sheet used for this extraction - drawn as a generic multi-pin family illustration (a row of >=8 pin positions with a break line), dimensioned per-pin/per-pitch so the numbers apply regardless of pin count; page 2 is an approval-signature cover page that names this exact part 'HX PZ2.54-1x5P ZZ' (LCSC C32713271, confirming the drawing sheet applies to our part); pages 3-5 (0-based 2-4) are a formal connector specification (materials, electrical performance, mechanical performance, solderability/endurance test tables); pages 6-7 (0-based 5-6) continue environmental endurance tests and packaging/transport/storage notes. Our part's pin count (5) is read off the drawing's own 'No. of / DIM.A / DIM.B' family table (row No.=5, highlighted on the sheet).

pinout.notes: Straight through-hole pin contact, position 1 of 5. No polarization/keying feature is depicted anywhere on the drawing sheet - the housing wafer segments repeat identically along the row.

land_pattern.notes: From the 'RECOMMEND P.C.B LAYOUT (TOP VIEW)' drawing on page 1 (PCB TOLERANCE +/-0.05 per the sheet) - this IS the vendor's recommended hole pattern. Recommended drill Ø1.02 mm per hole, pitch 2.54 mm (both dimensioned directly on that view). Overall span for our 5-pin part, read from the sheet's own 'No. of / DIM.A / DIM.B' family table at row No.=5: DIM.A = 10.16 mm (pin-1-to-pin-5 center span, = (5-1) x 2.54) and DIM.B = 12.70 mm (= 5 x 2.54; likely a layout/keepout envelope one half-pitch beyond each end pin, not separately explained on the sheet). Pin pitch 2.54 +/-0.1 mm is independently re-confirmed on a second side-view of the pin row (page 1) together with a pin cross-section callout SQ 0.64 mm (square, 0.64 x 0.64 mm). A SQ 0.64 mm pin's worst-case diagonal is 0.64 x sqrt(2) = 0.905 mm, which fits the vendor's own Ø1.02 mm hole with 0.115 mm diametral clearance. No copper LAND/pad diameter is given anywhere on this sheet - only the drill/hole pattern is dimensioned; pad_size_mm and annulus_mm are deliberately omitted rather than invented (see OPEN). Recommended PCB thickness for this part: 1.2-1.6 mm [spec text, page 3]. Note: the same top-view drawing separately dimensions a housing-wafer segment width of 2.50 mm (distinct from the 2.54 mm electrical/hole pitch) - not explained on the sheet, likely a molded-housing-vs-metal-contact tolerance artifact, not a PCB layout number.

layout_notes: Recommended PCB hole (drill): Ø1.02 mm per pin, pitch 2.54 mm [RECOMMEND P.C.B LAYOUT drawing, page 1]. The board's PULLED footprint uses a 1.10 mm drill - +0.08 mm OVER this recommendation (safe direction). Against the pin's own dimensioned cross-section (SQ 0.64 mm, worst-case diagonal 0.905 mm), the pulled 1.10 mm hole gives 0.195 mm diametral clearance (looser than the vendor's own 1.02 mm recommendation's 0.115 mm, but not undersized). Verdict: the pulled 1.10 mm drill comfortably accepts the pin and exceeds the vendor's recommended hole size - not a defect.

A single-pin side-view detail on page 1 dimensions two exposed pin-length segments either side of a small housing collar: 6.00 +/-0.2 mm and 3.00 +/-0.2 mm. The drawing does not label which segment is the upper mating pin vs the lower PCB solder-tail, so this file records both numbers without assigning them (see OPEN) - relevant to P6 for vertical clearance above/below the board once the orientation is confirmed.
Applicable PCB thickness per the formal spec (page 3): 1.2-1.6 mm.
Contact retention force >=10 N per pin (male and female contact); plug-in force <=3 N per pin; plug-out force <=0.5 N per pin [mechanical performance table, page 4].
Contact material: phosphor bronze, tin plated 3-4 um standard (a gold-flash 'Lips Wafer' variant also listed in the material table, page 3) [page 3].

abs_max.value: 240 C for 30-60 sec, or 260 C for 5 sec
